baseline_reference.dynamic_universe_evidence: per-rebalance PIT-safe selection with trailing lookback

inverse_vol_sizing.description: Replace equal-weight within top-N with 1/realized_vol weights
inverse_vol_sizing.rationale: Lower-vol positions get higher weight → reduces portfolio vol without sacrificing expected return

confidence_scaling.description: Scale total gross exposure by rolling signal IC strength
confidence_scaling.rationale: Reduce exposure when signal quality degrades, increase when strong

drawdown_threshold.conclusion: 10% is well-calibrated; 8% may help MaxDD slightly at PnL cost

sector_cap.note: Hardcoded in script (STAGE2_SECTOR_CAP_PCT), no CLI flag

top_n_stocks.note: Hardcoded in script (STAGE2_TOP_N_STOCKS), no CLI flag
top_n_stocks.conclusion: 15 is balanced; 20+ would dilute alpha, <10 would concentrate risk

rebalance_freq.conclusion: P9 dynamic rebalance already adjusts for vol regime
